task.title: Enable your preferred notifications
task.shortdesc: Select how you receive notifications from the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Hybrid Cloud Console. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
Events are configured in the console.
A Notifications administrator or Organization Administrator has configured behavior groups to receive event notifications.

prereq.note: If you are an Organization Administrator or Notifications administrator, you configure the notifications for users in your organization from Settings > Notifications. For detailed information, see Configure notifications for Hybrid Cloud Console services.

step.cmd: Click your user avatar in the upper right of the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console window. A drop-down list appears.
Click User Preferences. The My Notifications page opens.
Select the service you want to configure your notifications for, such as Advisor or User Access. A list of the available event notifications for the selected service opens.
At the top of the list, click Select all to enable all notifications for the service, or select one of the following options for each event listed:

ul.li: Daily digest: Receive a daily summary of triggered application events that occur in a 24 hour time frame.

Instant notification: Receive an email immediately for each triggered application event. For errata alerts, instant notifications are batched and sent in 15-minute intervals. If you select Instant notification for any service, you might receive a very large number of emails.
Weekly report: Receive an email that contains the Advisor Weekly Report.

step.cmd: Click Save to confirm your changes. Email notifications are delivered in the format and frequency that you selected. If notifications are configured for integrated third-party applications, the notifications are sent to those applications as well.

info.note: If you decide to stop receiving notifications, select Deselect all or uncheck the boxes for the events you do not want to be notified about, and then click Save. You will no longer receive any email notifications unless you return to this screen and enable them once again.
